paragraphs: R′ Menachem ben Segnai, Eduyot, chapter 7, mishnah 8. In the complete Yuchasin, the Yaavetz’s reading is Sanuai. We also find Rabbi Yehudah ben Signa in Eichah Rabbah 1:39, but there Hyman says the name should read bar Sisin.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Segnai, Sanuai and Signa are retained; bar Sisin is Hyman’s proposed correction of the last occurrence.

Mishnah Eduyot 7:8 names Menachem ben Signai; the checked Eichah Rabbah 1:39 names Rabbi Yehudah ben Signa reporting Rabbi Acha. Hyman says the latter should read bar Sisin. His corrective force is retained alongside the checked Signa reading. The complete Yuchasin’s reported Yaavetz reading Sanuai has not been directly collated. Hyman abbreviates Menachem’s title as ר׳; the checked Mishnah has no explicit title there, so the English retains R′.
